summary: Grab your shotgun and go duck hunting! Aiming is automatic, just tap to shoot!
description:
Go shoot ducks, deers and more on this action packed hunting game! Grab your trusty pump action or maybe automatic shotgun? Travel through various locations on foot or on truck!

Duckz! reimagines classic duck hunt as a new kind of fast paced shooting game! Aiming is automatic, just tap to shoot! But remember to shoot ahead of the bird, since you need to lead your target in this game.

If you like Duckz and are looking for more shotgun shooting, try our other title Clay Hunt PRO!

So grab your new pump action shotgun and get hunting!
